results.title: NFL players' push for grass should grow stronger after Jamal Adams MetLife Stadium injury
results.description: NFL players have been making a strong push for the league's 32 stadiums to all move to natural grass, and that push should only get louder and stronger following the preseason injury to Jamal Adams on Saturday.
